title: Quick Sort
definition: A Divide and Conquer algorithm that picks an element as a 'pivot' and partitions the array around the pivot (smaller elements before, larger after). Average O(N log N) time and O(log N) space. Unstable.
simpleExplanation: Picking a random person in the room, telling everyone shorter than them to go left, everyone taller to go right. Then doing it again for the left and right groups.
